notes.title: Progressive Patch 04 Announcement.
notes.content:
Hello Pilots! New Patch is out! There are the last features before the new content integration. Let's check what we added to the game. 

[h3]0.0957 - 0.0959 Version Patch Notes.[/h3]

[h1]Added Custom Keyboard and Controller (Key Binding)[/h1]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_2012a69127574a7aa4e215d71fd2674c~mv2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_0f2812000a2344b193a4af90a539f002~mv2.jpg[/img]

We added a binding keyboard and controller in the options menu. Be careful any customized will affect all UI and basic interactions on the controller. If it struggles you with any control, you can restore all the latest customized to be a default.
[h1]
Mentions list by players to try the binding[/h1]
[list]
[*] Invert Camera Axis.
[*] Swap Quick Boost Trigger and Customized by yours.
[*] Change your Fire Trigger.
[*] Any interchanged by yourself. 
[*] Let's try!
[/list]

[h1]Keyboard and Controller Mapping Screen[/h1]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_836706a3591f49e9a6c321b93f4a420f~mv2.jpg[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_fcd1618ea37f490ba467ca7f5d791113~mv2.jpg[/img]

It's related to Key Binding now. Any changes will affect all buttons that displaying on the mapping screen. Also, we have relocated some positions of the button to fit on the screen.

[h1]
All button guide icons match with Key Binding.[/h1]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_7090b62064c947f9a8c29d03379af88e~mv2.jpg[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_1e3b3104b73c4894bce004dd0b8ebbfe~mv2.jpg[/img]

All bound keys will affect the guide icons that appeared on Combat Screen, Tutorial, and also, all menus in the game. Please remind it also, affect on any latest saves.

More thing about key binding support, we removed the old joystick icon that displayed on the combat screen and replaced it with a dynamic button guide. It's also changeable by your latest binding.

[h1]Enabled Options Setting in Mission Mode.[/h1]
Now you can change game settings during the mission. Flexible settings and Key Binding were also available.

[h1]Enabled Collected and Use for Consumable items(Orbs).[/h1]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_7bc291069bde450591e6ade836cd64e5~mv2.jpg[/img]

Now all orb items that drop during the mission can be obtained and collected to the useable item stack on the top of the combat screen.

To use any items to fill your unit ammo, energy, and action points. You can press RB on Middle Click to call the small menu. It will show up to replace the skill wheel with 3 slots for your choosing. Item will use to fill the supply on the current playing unit. However, if the ammo, energy, and action point of the current unit are not full. That obtained item will automatically use when the unit got the item.

[h1]Released defensive attacks by enemies when using a skip battle.[/h1]

You can see the latest build. Enemies can't interact with the player if they triggered a skip battle on the new tactical view. Now it's activated. You will see the result of the attack by the enemy after using a skip battle. The condition depends on the defensive attribution of each enemy.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

About full binding key support. You can try and test as you want but, any change will affect the actual control you get used to. If some confusion happens on game control, you can use Restore to Default to roll back all settings and begin to set up again.  

We need some integration and improvement before the Big Update. Any change and patch will be updated on the STEAM Announcement first.

Tips: We lock both of Confirm and Cancel keys from actual binding but if you want to set them all you can Pull up and hold Right Analog Stick during the setting. You can bind all Confirm and Cancel Keys then.

Some Screenshots of new Mechs. More details are coming soon.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_268525e4d9a6476cac64b238889f9f06~mv2.jpg[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_9d5a195a70f5442287335071648df969~mv2.jpg[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_27ebfc3f919d4f309c2fae4e6e466997~mv2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Progressive Patch 03 Announcement.
notes.content:
[h3]Progressive Patch Announcement 03.[/h3]

The new preparation patch is ready. Our priority is still improving and fixing the new feature to work with the old feature smoothly. Now we focusing to add better methods to use any skills through the new tactical view and also working with the Skip Battle to support all skills we have. However, some quick patches may be out after this update with no notification. We are so sorry about that. So the new story also working along with the progressive patch and we will launch the news about it as soon as possible.

[h3]0.0957 - 0.0958.5 Version Patch Notes.[/h3]

[h3]New Feature Updates[/h3]

-Added "Side Attack" supports to all attack skills but still locked for an enemy. "Side Attack" will give an advantage for Damage Dealing of the different sides Front, Left, Right, Behind, Above, and Below the enemy.
-[Side Attack] Added the Vertical Slice plates that will appear on the ground when aiming at enemy units. Each plate is a different color to help the player indicate the specific side of the attack.
-[Shotgun] Vector Shot and Binary Array Skill are fixed for all firing algorithms. No random target anymore. Now players can indicate the order of fire with the order number that appeared above the aiming units. Also, new camera angles have been added.
-[Vertical Missile] Added the new method of Fire Landing on New Tactical View. Now you can select multiple targets by list choosing and enable to deploy the number of missiles you want.
-[New Tactical View] SMG, Shotgun, and Vertical Missle is enabled to use a Skip Battle with the same logic as a normal fire landing.
-[Tutorial] Added monitor mesh on Camera Test in tutorial Mode. Also decreased the degree of rotation in Left and Right camera test input.

[h3]Bug Fixing and Improvement.[/h3]

-Re-locate Damage Result Bar" on the right screen in combat mode.
-Enabled Counter and Defensive skills to land-able through Tactical View.
-Fixed wrong stat value displayed on Hangar Mode.
-Removed the duplicate order input during the Tactical View Order.
-[Cannon] Fixed UI overlay and freezing bugs when the player finished any turn or event by Cannon Attack. 
-Improved wrong torso angle when using Vector shot and Binary Array of Shotgun.
-We can check the equipped skills of all enemies on the map but still not support a low rate enemy like sentry guns and some unique boss units.
-A side Attack Result with Mech Icons has been added to the center of the screen.
-Improved the transition between Skirmish waves. Sometimes it's frozen the wave when finished the final enemy by Tactical View.
-Fixed weird walk backward after teleport ordered units with Skip Battle's On.
-Improve and fixed Split Screen Cut-In are wrong displaying the different side when attack.
-Fixed Camera Flicker after landed Vector Shots.
-Fixed the wrong D-Pad direction when selecting the buttons in Upgrade Panel.
-Removed Infinite Ammo when the player used Defensive and Counter Skills.
-[SMG] Fixed Combination Strike. Secondary draw skill is fired to the ground is fixed.
-[Vertical Missile] Removed hold trigger before placing the missile locator on Array Strike Skills. Now you can cast the Locator with a one-hit button. Also, it can place the AOE locator like a normal combat view with the new tactical view.
 
[h3]Conclusion.[/h3]

Skip Battle is the hardest part of integrating with fine playing. We taking a lot of time to compile all logic of the normal combat to work well with this feature as we can. Also, Some new UI still does not work smoothly with the old UI. That is the problem we are facing. That is why we have the no notification patches come out after the announced patch. More solid information will come after we have a good enough update. Sorry for some lost information sir!

[h3]Preparation[/h3]

You can see the Guard Command when using End Action Orders but we still do not deploy any shield parts right now. However, it is almost to finish the integration soon.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_49c466cd98a44114bd246fd066c07a56~mv2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_7eaccd5808434cd9a0a5cb5f01fcdc32~mv2.jpg[/img]
The Screenshots shows the new indicator on Vector Shots Skills of Shotgun.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_68adf59e2ab44eee8f911480783943d2~mv2.jpg[/img]
Vertical Slice Plate are displaying with Side Attack Notification.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_cb9a43fb825749b2977fff297ea9daf1~mv2.jpg[/img]
One of Shield Part we preparing to update to the game soon.

notes.content:
[h3]Progressive Patch Announcement 02.[/h3]

We are still in the preparation mode by the progressing update weekly. The main objective is the maintaining of New Tactical Views Input. Some skills are still partial support and working not the same as the actual combat view but we are working on it along with new missions preparing. However, we cannot provide the exact time date right now therefore we must be focusing on the features of the game first. 

[h3]0.0955 - 0.0956 Version Patch Notes.[/h3]

[h3]Bug Fixing[/h3]
-Fixed no EXP and WXP obtained after using both of Tactical Views to input any Battle
-Fixed wrong direction of Shotgun Aiming while using Tactical Views Inputs.
-Fixed Melee Attack cannot land the shot on New Tactical View. It's working right now. 
-Fixed Friendly Fire in New Tactical View.
-Improved wrong torso rotation when player unit using Defensive and Counter Skill. Now we can see better unit animation when they aim and track the movement of the enemy.
-Improved UI Overlapping when using Tactical View with any stage change.
-Fixed Incorrect Displaying a Component of Mission 03 Boss when the player sees it on the New Tactical Views.

-Improved Mission 03 Boss Camera when using Melee attack to that boss at too close range.
[h3]
Partially Added[/h3]
-Added the type of speed Slow, Normal, Speed compared with the amount of weight. (We will add more Types of Speed to indicate how fast of your units soon)
-Added Plus and Minus circle buttons to all upgrade menus and fixed them to work correctly.
-Blocked the Tactical View Locater not going out of the battlefield and falling from the base terrain sometimes.

[h3]Tuning[/h3]
-Adjusts Defensive Skill to place any shots when the enemies almost stop moving in their turn. 
-Tuning Shot Landing Locater. Now we can place the shot on the higher floor and also Booster Jump Locator Placement.
-Added more D-Pad, WASD, and Arrow Buttons supports on Hangar Menu. Now the player can input the selection to anywhere of Hangar UI and also, the player can hold the button to keep moving the selection but still not 100% supported.

[h3]Incoming Feature[/h3]
-Shield Module

We will update one of the incoming features soon along with Bug Fixing and Current Features Improving. It's will come in a couple of weeks.

Please Be careful about a Skip Battle Option in Tactical Views Input. It's still not correctly working. We improving this feature and need more time to complete it.

notes.title: Progressive Patch 01 Announcement.
notes.content:
[h3]Progressive Patch 01 Announcement.
[/h3]
We are truly sorry for the plan was changed but we already updated the preparation patch first before the real major patch is ready.  We will update the game step by step with the new features by progression until it was solid enough for the main progression. Please check the patch notes for the details.

[h3]0.0951 - 0.0952 Version Patch Notes.[/h3]

[h3]Drone Tactical View and Eyes Tactical View. 
[/h3]
	The Switchable management views have been added. Drone and Eyes Tactical Views will give the player to manage all actions along with The Actual Combat Mode and be able to switch between all three views anytime they want.

	If the player wants to play the tactical like top-down turn-based theme. They can switch to the Drone Tactical View. This mode will transition the camera to a top-down perspective and display more info about the tactical term and all units in the field map. Also, players can switch to The Eyes Tactical View for the different POV like FPS view and get the same features as The Drone Tactical View.

[h3]Tactical View Locator.	[/h3]
	In the Drone and Eyes Tactical Views, we added a moveable locator that can move around the map and enable it to give units a general order like a tactical game. Players can draw the walking path or pinned the destination with the locator and also give the unit the order to fire enemies via both tactical views.
[h3]
New Indicators Added.[/h3]
	Follow both of Tactical Views were updated to the game. We Added more UI to give more information about the unit through the Tactical Views. You can use the locater to check the performance of any unit and indicated the range of weapons that can accept the order.
[h3]
Component Sighting[/h3]
	Added the new UI to indicate the chance of damage will affect the separated parts. In the aiming view, you can see the Component Sighting Bar and part buttons with the percentage value. It's not like the bullet percentage but it displays the percentage of what's part will hit the bullet. A percentage will increased or decreased depending on the part you are aiming for.

[h3]Enable Specific Component by Melee Attack[/h3]
	You can use Component Sighting to select the specific component
you want freely. Chance will be increased or decreased depends the main part you select. Use a direction button or D-Pad to select the component during the aiming mode.

[h3]AI and Animation Improvement.[/h3]
-Unit Rotation Animation Improved.
-Multiple Angle and Arc Moving Path are Improved.
-Avoiding Objects and Obstacles are improved.
-Disable Counter Aim and replaced it by Counter Delay.

[h3]Hangar UI Changed.[/h3]
	We applied some new graphics to the Hangar UI. We changed from Guage Based to Text-Based with the new scaling of fonts and relocated any status following the priorities. However, it's still in the progression, some features will not work 100% but, we updating the improvement soon.
[h3]
Partial Tool Tips Applied.[/h3]
	The information tips have been added to the Hangar menu first. Also in the progression. It's still only applied in Mouse & Keyboard mode and is not ready for all language support.

[h3]Minor Update, Etc.[/h3]
-Added Graphic to the Mini Map.
-Added Quick Zoom on SMG and SG.
-Added Command Guide to the Combat Mode and Tactical Views on Right Bottom Screen.
-Limited the missile range matched will max range value of that missile weapon.
-Canceling Action on Enemies AI was applied. It depends on the max range that the enemy can detect. 
-Added the circular dots line into the Shotgun when aiming for the range indicate.
-Added an area guide into the Splash Strike Skill on SMG.
-Added the partial Split-Screen when the attack is the multiple targets.
-Booster Jump was added. 
-Walking Sound improved.
-Wheel Boost Sound Improved.
-Partial Drag & Drop are available at Parts and Weapons Equip.
-Partial font changed.

[h3]Conclusion.[/h3]
We have held some key updates like New Mechs and Story Missions before the launch and need to update more progression for incoming progressive patches soon. Until it was ready we will improve the game first and will announce the specific date later. Maybe encountering new bugs but we are working to patch up the fix will very soon. Sorry to have taken you so long from the latest patch. More progression is coming.

notes.title: Pre Major Patch Information is ready, let's check it out!
notes.content:
First and importantly, we apologize for the delay once again, but we now have a firm date for the major update: December 22nd, 2021. It took too long, and you were disappointed that you had to wait very long for our update. However, we want to share some progression of the game before the 3 months of rollout. Let's check this out.
[h3]
New Tactical View Features[/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_a9ff24e999494d38af32da1c96772d13~mv2.gif[/img]

You can see some screenshots from the update we added before. We finding a way to add more tactical features into the game. Example, How to landing any attack, indicate the range, and more helpers to use a Tactical View.


[h3]Switch-able between combat mode and tactical view.[/h3]

From the first version, the game has not allowed players to switch between the Combat Mode and Tactical View. Yes, we can do it in the major update. This feature will help the player to know the range and indicate all enemies in the area. It's available with two different views, Top-Down and Third Person View.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_8a2123d596d940b0942e823bfcbe9ea6~mv2.gif[/img]
[h3]
Tactical View Pointer[/h3]
The moveable pointer can be used to indicate the direction of moves and shot landing. It can use to indicate how GP Gauge is required for the moving range. And also helping the player to see the situation around. More thing, this pointer is also the status checker if the player puts it on any unit position.

More thing about the Tactical View. The yellow arrows line will help the player to check attackable enemies and also determine which weapons can use from the color tap at the top of the screen.
[h3]
Pin and Auto Move.[/h3]
A new helper can be used to pin the destination to guide your move. Using a pointer to place a circle border on the area you mark. You can use it if you want to control any mech yourself but you can do it with Auto Move too. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_f3c7b0913559402a8c846e8eceba2c5d~mv2.gif[/img]

[h3]Move and Attack[/h3]
After marking the area you want to move. You can choose "Move & Attack" to finish your role. It's available to use for all skills. All processions will run automatically but all enemies can do the defensive attack too. Please be careful and indicate any enemy units as well.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_9072cdd88eb34faf8259d278ac1153f4~mv2.gif[/img]

[h3]AI Improvement and Path Finding Improvement
[/h3]
From the latest version. All AIs only walk in one direction. They are unable to change or making any curves moving. We already improved it. Also, more abilities to avoid any obstacles on the battlefield and more stage animations for all AIs. We will add some videos about it soon. 


[h3]New Missions
[/h3]
5 story missions are confirmed added to the game and more are coming before the update. Including new enemies and a new Boss Unit. Also, some changed gameplay on the first 3+1 missions from the initial version. The keywords of Sand and Space are still in play. We will update some screenshots soon.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_42f1df531eb944fda360d3f3dd0ac799~mv2.gif[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_f6a7731196d446b499dc951a63c52947~mv2.gif[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_07c321363d5643538f5cbbb9278f6491~mv2.gif[/img]

[h3]New Mechs[/h3]

Introduce a new set of five mechas that will be released with the next phase update. Information about names and some features will be updated on Twitter and Facebook before. However, in this major update, we plan to show a hover mech system first. It's will be a playable module and also the enemy AI. Some details of the design may change before the launch. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_979ae6a2b7534e4fb163d23119a39f88~mv2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: November Development Update.
notes.content:
Hi commander, The development is ongoing. we have some progression to provide you before the end of this month. Let check this out!

**Note**
This is just the development progress not the patch updated!

[h3]New Tactical View[/h3]

You may saw some piece of the screenshot we already provided before. The new tactical view will allow players to place a marker called "Contact Zone" to landing the attack or making a position with the right prediction range. It's similar to the first tactical view but not the same at all. Player can switch the mode during the combat every time and providing 2 ways to switch the mode Top-Down, and Cockpit View to handle the tactical perspective. Not only just the selector view from old. More indicators also adding to this module.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_55103af4f1944d5085dcad67da64f1c0~mv2.gif[/img]
The screenshot showing the transition between top-down tactical view and combat view. Locator is the one important thing for the player can use to mark the destination or indicate all beside units.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_2af4a875ef09492e8b6f43e901094dbc~mv2.gif[/img]
Not only top-down tactical view. Player can open the cockpit view to create a "Contact Zone" or indicate any enemies nearby through the FPS view (We can call this one a cockpit view). 

** Contact Zone will give some benefit for the ordering unit example Bonus ATK, Critical, and Accuracy.

[h3]More Indicator[/h3]

The new tactical view also adding a new unit indicator. A player can use the locator to see the unit status on both sides, Allies, and Enemies. That's support both between Top-Down and Cockpit Tactical View.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_0cb18006437640e0a80da5e7111c9623~mv2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Cylinder Area for weapon[/h3]

We also add the circle dashed line to indicate the weapon range. It's good for a mid-range weapon that has a range between 0-50 meters to see the dashed line. Perhaps different for the long range weapon. Cannot confirm a circle dashed line will add into all weapons.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_18e3c3cda5644b8e870ebf433f0ec2f3~mv2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Component Aiming[/h3]

This is more indicator related to the combat view. The latest system, component aiming is working behind non-information UI. You  doesn't know any percentage of accuracy per part but, The new UI will let you see them all and make the advantage when you are specify the part to landing the shot.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_e1371285603a4a89abd21360dc13ea73~mv2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Customization Menu[/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_06122f7cfa354ee19987f117972b85f6~mv2.gif[/img]

The screenshot showing Tool tips & Drag-Drop Support. That also adds to the customization menu. You can equip parts or skills through drag and drop and also see the quick info by tool tips we're adding. Yes, will support to drag and drop part very soon.

[h3]The new position of Emblem Decal[/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_3c794da7677440119dfaf28131aea1f8~mv2.jpg[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_cd0acef4722646c6896d06ab7d37a821~mv2.jpg[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_33faa68e9ad144e9871026129006e027~mv2.jpg[/img]

A set of screenshots showing a little bit touch-up on the mech decoration. Emblem Decal is already adjust the position and also appear on the shoulder shield for the better proportion.  So we got some complaints about color customization UX/UI from our users. Yes we still need to work a lot to improve it!

[h3]Summary[/h3]

The November update is just the progression about the system integration only. This is challenge to blend a batch of permanent change that coming to the system but, also need the game run smoothly. We must check and improve a while before providing the patch. The next update will provide some preview before the patch. Yes some new contents also coming. Keep follow us tightly, Commander!

Dual Gear first Development base on the Console versions but, we roll out in PC first. This is our challenge to keep both things going better.

Most of request by our communities are including in we mention above. However, feel free to give your feedback or critic into our communities. We always stay with you all the time, pilots!

Hi pilots!

From the past 17th June after the update of Beta Backer. We start working to put some amount of fixing on this Beta version immediately but, still no info provided. This current version is 0.0834 and we are ready to take a place with 0.080-0.083 Patch Notes, Let’s checking how was changed!

We’ve deployed the first Beta build with semi-working of Mouse/Keyboard Support, around 50-60% functional. To unleash more potential of the game, this is our first mission to bring the game smoothly run.

[h2][b]Mouse/ Keyboard support for Intermission Menu.[/b][/h2]

- Mouse/ Keyboard supported 80% for “Customization Menu”.

- Dynamic rollover and clicking are working on “Unit Structuring” and “Weapon Attachment”

- Skill Setup by clicking is opened. Mouse wheel has been supported to turn around the skill wheel for slots selection.

- “Coloring Unit” supports, player can use the clicking method to customize mech color by real-time. Slide-bar dragging is open now.

[previewyoutube=MTYAwgoYeUE;full][/previewyoutube]

- Enchanted the clicking flow on “Unit Loader” Menu, improving the method of unit selection for mission deployment.

- Changed some Keyboard mapping on header and footer to match with the latest inputs.

[h2][b]Mouse/ Keyboard support for Combat Gameplay.[/b][/h2]

- Basic clicking to end the character dialog is enabled.

- Bring the left click to call Turn Oder menu, Right-Click to end Unit Turn is ready.

[img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_695/v1593860742/labyvmj2twm3sgsqwl58.jpg[/img]

Bug Fixing List

- Solved Deadlock Stage on Mission 03! DGs AI cast some counter-attacks during the player turn is removed. Random freeze after AI attack’s also.

- Removed overlay stage version 0.1’s provided! Still investigating more UI overlays case but, removed “Dead Lock” is first priority.

- AI path prediction’s freeze when repeating save play has been fixed! Still, happen sometime on Mission 04 Boss but, nearly successfully solved.

- Fixed remains bullet can be shoot out!

- Wrong location of Mission 03, 04 displaying on Mission Select menu were fixed.

- Wrong Weapon models displaying fixed! Still investigating more cases

- Improved inputs of "Tactical View" Easier to switch the different view tabs.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/XaMAiMrGZtYbxjhOM0/giphy.gif[/img]
[h2]
[b]Game Balance[/b][/h2]

- Wrong Accuracy(ACC) values showing in the game’s fixed(Not at all for now) The game separated the unit structure ACC and Specific Weapon ACC. Players can see both values from the Tactical View. However, these two factors will be merged when using skills to attack. Some Information about unit status still hard to see but we will improve that soon.

- Weapon auto level from the initial value to the second level upgrade’s been removed. This bug showing the wrong weapon status after bought some from NEMOS Shop. Now we can see the same of their values in any information panels.

- Weapon tuning V.01’s engaged!

- Mission 04( Third on Beta Backer) Changed the ATK of Cannon DG that stationary attack over the high platform.

- Improve Boss Logic for Mission 04, Darkengard Boss. Add more sense for two behavior modes, Spider and Standing. Allow players to get closer at the right time to put the right skills.

- Still Mission 04 Boss, removed last component appeared after destroyed all 6 components of that Mech Boss. Added Supply Items drop to the individual component’s been destroyed.

- Status Panels in the Customization Menu beginning to showing the right information, some conflicted still displaying, but we’ve to finalize them soon.

- Shop Pricing fixed, differ from launch.

- Upgrade pricing effective from the based price’s activated. Including with sold items, the price constraints with upgrade level right now.

[h2][b]Screenshots for Summary Updated![/b][/h2]

[img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_695/v1593858701/safhnafuzk7nc7rdmzsz.jpg[/img]

[img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_695/v1593861727/hjmfnuntthhsc0n4hkub.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]0.083 Patch Conclusions[/b][/h2]

We started to update some amount sub-patch called “HotFixed” immediately after the first ignition of the Beta Backer. Encountering with expected and unexpected issues happen all the time. However, the first major we aim for the Lock stage solving alongside by Mouse/Keyboard Support. A lot of un-precise issues still displaying. Yes, some unpolished things scattering in the game. The Improve is coming on 0.084 Patch! We’re preparing to launch on STEAM EARLY ACCESS this July 2020! Announcement and New Press Kit is coming very soon!

notes.content:
[b][img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_695/v1592059611/jkgnkkbiectaz5p20zkx.jpg[/img][/b]


We apologies again for the huge batch of delays from the last year but, we confirmed, this 17th June is going on. The confirmation email will send to all backers from 17-18th June and will receive a Steam Key not over 24 hours after the completion. If you already for the Alpha/Beta Backer and the game is already in your STEAM Library, don't do anything. The game will update the new patch automatically! 

[h3] How to preparation. [/h3]


-The confirmation process is the same as Alpha/Beta Backer.
-All chosen perks will receive the Steam Key for this Beta Backer Phase!
-The confirmation email will send to your registered email in your Indiegogo account. If you are the non-registered backer, you can check your account by Facebook login option at the top right of the Indiegogo page.
- If you've forgotten your registered email. Feel free to contact our support email at pongpat@dualgeargame.com We will help you to get your key anyway.
- Some confirmation mail may be dropped into your trash folder. Don't forget to check it!

[h3]Progression Update![/h3]


We've been updated some of the new progressions on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/DUALGEARGAME]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/DUALGEARGAME]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaPISZ5aCsDBRcortUge5Yg]Youtube[/url] during the preparation of Beta Backer, Let's check it out!

[previewyoutube=YzlBphMZf-M;full][/previewyoutube]

All available weapons during the pre-alpha demo and alpha released got the batch of skills.  Like an RPG game, player needs to gains the character level to upgrade more skills and status. All are available for Beta Backer.

[h3]Agressive Gameplay Implementation.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=EOrtzuUvlK4;full][/previewyoutube]

This is "Wheel Boost" The feature already in Alpha Release but we have no official details about it. We bring more aggressive control to the latest version alongside with tougher AI. All enemies are able to activate the "Defensive Attack" during any action of the player unit. Wheel boost will help player to avoid the defensive attack and more benefit to getting to the destination quickly.

[h3]Story Integrations.[/h3]

More details will announce after the launch of Beta Backer.

notes.title: Final Patch for Closed Alpha updated! (Alpha Release 0.91)
notes.content:
[b]DG Update 0077[/b]

[b][img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_620/v1498415621/ilort3jimlowguvjtw3r.jpg[/img][/b]

Final Patch for Closed Alpha updated! (Alpha Release 0.91)

Hi pilots,

The last update for the Alpha version has been launch! Yes, it means BETA development has begun but... right now, Let check out what we improve on to the current version.

This current build has improved some gameplay with the keyword "Faster" The new features " Wheel Boost" is an important key. We put it to the combat gameplay and also AI behavior. Now a player can press a button x, to move faster with wheel boost. That's the better way if the player wants a fast gameplay.
We recommend a try it until you are the expert in the boost control. You can be like the ACE pilot! Try it to get your position, dodge the enemies attack, and evade the massive missile!

Also, enemies AI is open to use a wheel boost. During the enemy phase, this feature is the key to making all actions to be faster. They can make decisions to use a Wheel Boost. If using a scene speed button(A), all action and cutscenes during the turn will be extra fast and quickly to go for the next phase. Wheel boost and scene speed will help all player so much to make more compact combat and decrease a time during the turns in gameplay.

[img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_620/v1498415681/hzj0lblksr9ttjyezd6y.jpg[/img]

About the major issues from the later versions. We fixed a lot of freezing bugs appear from any overlaps stage. Becuase DUAL GAER is a base event control blending with the real-time actions. The timing of each event stage may conflict during the real-time are progressing. That is the priority problem we want to focus and fix them. Hope we did it about the 90% right now.

One more thing, we added a new aircraft mech enemy for testing play in the Bitsummit Mission #1, #2. This mech is showing the combination mech in the combat gameplay and also, how the player takes a fight with giant aircraft enemy. If you have an alpha build, don't forget to try those missions and take down that guy!

[img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_620/v1498415789/ifdejwqyyo0efzrrdwno.jpg[/img]

[img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_620/v1498415823/zj5cvqdrpwia7uucqxxq.jpg[/img]

[img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_620/v1498415916/ad0lmzugpttqpdumq25y.jpg[/img]

We plan for this patch will get more missions, parts, and weapons but we're sorry we can't provide them for now. However, we will put it's all into the next beta phase. One reason because the new item management modules are going for the big upgrade. Example; Shop, Weapon development, and the weapons obtained from an enemy. We think it's better if all of them should be ready with the full progress of all items module and the reason, for the awesome BETA! Yes, a lot of new progress is coming in the next update! Stay tuned pilots!

Closed Alpha 0.91 (Alpha Release) Added-fixed lists

-Wheel Boost input added( let's remind to Roller Dash from FMO.) All player can try to use it by X(Shift) button when the unit is completely stationary.
-Integrated a wheel boost to AIs behavior. The timing of enemy phase will shorter with faster movement on each enemy. 
-Chain Attack enabled for all current weapon skills.
-Run animation will changes when the unit was high weight setting.
-2 Exclusive Missions from Bitsummit 2017. We put a newly aircraft mech to be a boss for those two missions.
-Resolved the freezing bugs happens from the overlaps event stage Active counter stage and player combat view 
-Plasma rifle DG in MESSA mission and his team can move when the first player unit get to the contact area.
-Endless shots bug of tank enemy fixed.
-Controller and Mouse/Keyboard guides added to hangar screen.
-Active-Counter system enables for all movement stage. (Cast the attack during the target moving.)
-Speed up the scene in enemy phase is applied. Hold A button(Enter) during the enemy turn.
-Improves some skill cutscene camera, animation seamless, and some interactive on HUD and UI when the unit is getting the damage.

On the current build, we know some issues and bugs are not 100% completely resolved. We promised on the next BETA version will be better and coming with the big update!

[b]DG Update 0069[/b]

Hi pilots!

Sorry for a long time no update after the great new year has begun. We still working about the new features, mechs, new missions, and also a better things for
PC player. For now, we have a little progression showing to you all about "mouse support" and "tactical view" the feature allow player swith and ordering the units. Let see a WIP videos. We are showing Mouse system working on Hangar mode and short clip about tactical view. Let's check it out!

[b]Mouse Support Feature.[/b]

"2 minutes video preview a mouse working on hangar mode"
[url=https://youtu.be/w6TGWiGzJrQ]https://youtu.be/w6TGWiGzJrQ[/url]

We adding a mouse system to make a comfortable more for STEAM version.The rollover effect are able to use when the player move a cursor to any buttons.
It's showing the overlay UI box on any clicking locations. Also, player can use a drag and slide on color adjustment mode. So don't worry about the controller support, it's also working with the same pattern.

[b]Tactical View on Animation and how it's working.[/b]

[url=https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_5cfcc934a6b445e69b8355df976330b7~mv2.gif][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_5cfcc934a6b445e69b8355df976330b7~mv2.gif[/img][/url]

When you going on the mission, the game will switch your screen to the top-down Isometric view. We call this stage with " Tactical View". You can check all about the detail from any unit and able to switch for next or previous units you want to play. So Did you see a DDE link? This feature are about chain combination attack. You will see a Yellow Link Line and Link Rate bar above your team units. You can use a special ability of each skills to make a chance for create more damage from chain attack. We will integrate to the game soon(not for next version)

[url=https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_47ad67ecd3d54896afe9b185a885997e~mv2.jpg][img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_620/v1485606640/avpoe7eiposhnolehadg.jpg[/img][/url]

We adding "End Action Order" when player stop the unit and need to switch or end the turn. Not only about switch or end your turn, player are able to choose a defend or cover. There are a ways to make a different action and when the enemy turn start.

[b]Head part is destructible.[/b]

[url=https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7ce486_17e065ddb9024a959295f31d56a9c6ca~mv2.jpg][img]https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_620/v1485606958/mp9kxoqw91dhnohuodv5.jpg[/img][/url]

From the lastest earlier builds. All head part can not destroy but the player can see only AP and CP decrease to zero. That's mean the unit has been lost a head part but the head model still appear on the unit. So the next build if you lost any head part, the unit will lost accuracy and evasion abilities. Pls be careful

[b]The Date for a next patch![/b]
The next patch will coming with a little features integrated, Tactical view and some part for mouse support. There are a semi update before last patch for closed-alpha and we will patch up to the STEAM on a first of February!

Have a great new year 2017 pilot!

notes.title: Development Update!!
notes.content:
Development Friday!!

Hey, Everyone! Very long time no update here! Now! We have a small updated on the upcoming Build Version exclusively for the backers. The leader of your Dual Gear squad will show up on the start screen now (along with all of the customization). We are now working hard on new Missions and new enemies, stay tune guys!

[img]http://www.dualgeargame.com/img/17062016ss01.png[/img]
[img]http://www.dualgeargame.com/img/17062016ss02.png[/img]
[img]http://www.dualgeargame.com/img/17062016ss03.png[/img]

Slash Weapons Update!!

Some screenshots about new models of slash weapon! These Unique weapons will be different from the sword that was in the pre-alpha. The Long Blade have good range and agile weapon. Despite its short range, the Explosive spike is an excellent explosive melee weapon. The High-frequency Sword is an extremely powerful weapon. It has Huge damage potential at the cost of high energy consumption. All three weapons will be in the Close Alpha build of Dual Gear!

[img]http://www.dualgeargame.com/img/DG_slashweapons_team01.png[/img]
[img]http://www.dualgeargame.com/img/DG_Mono_Molecular_Blade.png[/img]
[img]http://www.dualgeargame.com/img/DG_High_Frequency_Blade.png[/img]
[img]http://www.dualgeargame.com/img/DG_Explosive_Spike.png[/img]

After long time no update. We would like to apologies to everyone as unfortunately we are unable to release the Close Alpha( for backers) in time this month. We will inform you in the near future on when it will be available soon.
The Key for the Close-Alpha will be sent to the Backers soon (STEAM ALPHA/BETA PILOT and THE VETERAN(and above). The first build will finally have the Mech customization available to the player for the first time! After that, there will be regular update with new asset and more.

Not only on store page! Follow us on FB and Twitter to get our new update!!
[url]https://www.facebook.com/DUALGEARGAME/[/url]
[url]https://twitter.com/DUALGEARGAME[/url]
